title: The Flood and the Flicker
tagline: The data they always wanted, and the night they almost lost it.
lesson: Alone, each of you can do exactly one thing well. Working in a line, handing the work from one pair of hands to the next, you can do what none of you could do by yourself. Asking for help isn't giving up — it's how the chain begins.
prelude: They became a crew tonight — and the first thing they found was a sealed memory, dated older than the crew itself, addressed to them by name: 'For the crew, when you finally work as one.' Next issue: the crew opens the letter written before they existed.

title: The Letter Before the Crew
tagline: Somebody was here before them — and left a chair pulled out.
lesson: You don't have to be good at everything. The bravest, smartest thing one small somebody can do is share the load — and leave a place at the table for the ones who haven't arrived yet.
prelude: The eighteenth slot — empty, shaped like 'someone who listens' — began to glow on its own, lit by a faint signal climbing up the deep power grid from out past the wall. A few of the crew go down the wire to find the one Zero left a place for.
